name: CamGuard
author: duarte-gui
description: Frigate NVR cameras in the Omarchy bar: a live snapshot grid, a floating always-on-top PiP with the real RTSP stream, and desktop alerts filtered by zone that replay the recording when you click them.

barWidget.description: Watch your Frigate cameras without leaving what you are doing: a 2x2 live grid in the bar, a floating picture-in-picture overlay that plays both the live stream and the recording of a detection, and notifications only for the zones you care about.

schema.label: Frigate URL
schema.description: Base address of the Frigate web API, for example http://192.168.0.10:5000. Snapshots, events and camera health all come from here.

schema.label: go2rtc RTSP URL
schema.description: Base address of the go2rtc restream bundled with Frigate. Used only by the picture-in-picture overlay.

schema.label: Cameras
schema.description: Comma-separated list of frigateName:subStream[:mainStream]|Label, for example gate:gate_sub:gate_main|Gate. The Frigate name must match exactly, capitals included. Leave empty to discover every camera from /api/config.

schema.label: Grid refresh (ms)
schema.description: How often each tile pulls a fresh snapshot. Only runs while the panel is open, so a fast rate costs nothing when it is closed.

schema.label: Snapshot height (px)
schema.description: Height Frigate scales each snapshot to before sending it. Lower is lighter on the network.

schema.label: Event poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often Frigate is asked for new detections. This is what drives both the bar badge and the notifications.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a detection enters one of the zones below. Clicking the notification opens that camera in the overlay.

schema.label: Notify only for these zones
schema.description: Zone names, optionally scoped as camera:zone. Empty means every zone Frigate defines; an explicit empty list means none. The gear button in the panel writes this for you. A detection that never enters a zone never notifies.

schema.label: Notify only for these objects
schema.description: Comma-separated Frigate labels, for example person, car. Empty means any tracked object.

schema.label: Clicking a notification
schema.description: clip replays the recording of that detection in the overlay. Frigate only writes a clip once the event ends, so the overlay waits for it and says so. live jumps straight to the camera instead.

schema.label: Clip wait (seconds)
schema.description: How long to wait for Frigate to finish writing a clip before giving up. An event that ended and still has no clip is given up on much sooner, because its zone is not covered by that camera's record required_zones and no clip is ever coming.

schema.label: Notification cooldown (seconds)
schema.description: Minimum gap between two notifications from the same camera, so one person walking around does not produce a burst.

schema.label: Badge window (minutes)
schema.description: How far back the detection counter on the bar icon looks.

schema.label: Overlay player
schema.description: native draws the stream inside the shell as an always-on-top layer that never takes keyboard focus. mpv spawns an external window instead, which needs the Hyprland rules from the README but decodes on the GPU.

schema.label: Overlay stream
schema.description: sub is the low-resolution detect stream and is far lighter. main is the full-resolution recording stream.

schema.label: Overlay corner
schema.description: Where the overlay first appears. You can always drag it somewhere else.

schema.label: Overlay width (% of screen)
schema.description: Width of the overlay as a share of the screen. Height follows at 16:9.

schema.label: Overlay margin (px)
schema.description: Gap between the overlay and the screen edges.

schema.label: Overlay audio
schema.description: Play the camera audio track. Off by default so the overlay stays a glance, not an interruption.

schema.label: Extra mpv arguments
schema.description: Only used when the overlay player is mpv.
